lines.en: label osakospring8:
scene dorm
Ahh, the dorms — that magical location that feels more like the Backrooms than a safe place for girls to hang out and masturbate sometimes.
lines.zh: 啊,宿舍——那块神奇的地方,比起女孩们偶尔聚在一起自慰的安全场所,它感觉上更像「后室」。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say you can’t masturbate in the Backrooms. You probably can. And it would probably be awesome. But it would also probably be scary. Which is also what the dorms are like. Maybe. Scary.
lines.zh: 这不是说你不能在后室里自慰。你大概可以。而且大概会很爽。但大概也会很吓人。而宿舍也是这么个感觉。也许吧。吓人。

lines.en: Or at least scary-adjacent. Because, when you sit down and think about nightmares or sorrow or any of the other negative stuff you’ve come to associate with this game, the greatest concentration of it has occurred within these walls.
lines.zh: 或者至少,和「吓人」沾亲带故。因为,当你坐下来想想噩梦、悲伤、或任何你已将其与这款游戏关联起来的负面事物,它们最浓密的聚集地,就发生在这四面墙之内。

lines.en: There are twenty girls in here. Not right now, but as a whole. Sometimes even more when the world breaks. And each one of them has their own troubles, trials, and tribadism. Err...tribulations.
lines.zh: 这栋楼里有二十个女孩。不是此刻,而是总数。当世界崩坏时,有时还会更多。而她们每个人都有自己的烦恼、试炼,和女同性恋式摩擦。呃……磨炼。

lines.en: Sorry, just thinking about masturbating again. And how negative emotions aren’t the only thing highly concentrated here since puberty is a violent beast.
lines.zh: 抱歉,我又想起自慰了。顺便想起,这里高度浓缩的也不只是负面情绪——毕竟青春期是一头暴烈的野兽。

lines.en: Right now, no one was masturbating. Sad. And no one was really thinking about it either.
lines.zh: 此刻,没有人在自慰。真遗憾。也没有人真的在想这件事。

lines.en: Except for me, of course. But that doesn’t mean much since I’m not Akira Arakawa.
lines.zh: 当然,除了我。但这说明不了什么,因为我又不是 Akira Arakawa。

lines.en: In fact, I’m not really here at all! And selecting the dorms today was just the trigger you needed to activate a completely unrelated event! Congratulations!
lines.zh: 事实上,我根本就不在这里!而今天选择宿舍这个地点,只是你需要的一个扳机,用来触发一场毫不相干的事件!恭喜!

lines.en: Here’s more melancholy.
lines.zh: 接下来是更多忧郁。

lines.en: : Hm? Coming! One sec!
lines.zh: : 嗯?来啦!稍等!

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm1
: Uhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : H...Heeeey...
: Well, this is...not something that has ever happened before.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛,这可是……从没发生过的事。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm2
: Is this weird? This is definitely weird. It is, right?
lines.zh: : 这很怪吧?这绝对很怪。对吧?

lines.en: : The...the flowers? No, they...they seem pretty standard to me. Are they...a gift for Miss Watabe or something?
lines.zh: : 花……花吗?不,它们……它们在我看来挺普通的。是……送给 Watabe 老师的礼物之类的吗?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm3
: I should go. I’m getting college flashbacks right now. Sorry for suddenly knowing where you live.
lines.zh: : 我该走了。我现在正涌起大学时代的闪回。抱歉突然知道你住哪儿。

lines.en: : Miss Osaka, what’s going on? What are you doing here? And why are you asking me about flowers?
lines.zh: : Osaka 老师,出什么事了?你来这里干什么?还有你为什么问我花的事?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm4
: I’m not. This is all a dream. I was never actually here and, in a few minutes, you’re going to wake up and forget all about it.
lines.zh: : 我没有出事。这一切都是梦。我根本没来过,几分钟后你就会醒来,把这一切忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...okay then? Not very believable given what my dreams have been like lately, but I guess nice surprises aren’t ever really out of the question.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……那,好吧?考虑到我最近的梦都是什么样子,这说法不太可信,不过我想,美好的惊喜倒也从来不是完全不可能。

lines.en: : So do I just...lie back down or-
lines.zh: : 所以我就……躺回去,还是——

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm5
: Oh, God fucking damn it.
lines.zh: : 哦,老天他娘的该死。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm6
: The flowers are for you, not Wakana. A friend of mine got me into the habit of trying to cheer people up with gifts and, without beating around the bush, I think you might...need that.
lines.zh: : 花是给你的,不是给 Wakana 的。我的一位朋友让我养成了用礼物哄人开心的习惯,而我就直说了,我觉得你也许……需要这个。

lines.en: : Need...to be cheered up? Why? I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 需要……被哄开心?为什么?我挺好的。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm7
: Cool. Well, they’re non-refundable, so I think you should take them anyway. And, in the event that you stop feeling fine, look at them and remember someone cares.
lines.zh: : 酷。嗯,这花不能退货,所以我觉得你还是收下吧。还有,万一你哪天不再觉得挺好,就看看它们,记住有个人在乎你。

lines.en: : Or just let them die. That’s fine too. They were kind of cheap, to be honest. I got them from the convenience store.
lines.zh: : 或者就让它们枯死也行。那也没什么。说实话,它们挺便宜的。我在便利店买的。

lines.en: : I should go.
lines.zh: : 我该走了。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm8
: Oh...okay. We’re hugging now. That’s a thing I expected to happen.
lines.zh: : 哦……好。我们现在在拥抱了。这是我有预料到会发生的事。

lines.en: : Thank you...I needed this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……我需要这个。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm9
: Yeah, of course. You don’t need to thank me. Just...talk to me. If you want to, I mean. It’s just...pretending to be okay isn’t going to help you at all and I’ve been really worried lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯,应该的。你不用谢我。就是……跟我说说。我是说,如果你想的话。只是……假装没事对你一点帮助都没有,而我最近真的很担心。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to talk about it, that’s the problem.
lines.zh: : 问题就在于,我不知道该怎么谈。

lines.en: : Is it really that? Or is it just...not having someone to talk to?
lines.zh: : 真的是那样吗?还是只是……没有一个可以说话的人?

lines.en: : A little of both I guess...I can talk to Sensei, but you know how he is. There’s Sara too but that doesn’t feel right either. And all my friends are just...
lines.zh: : 我猜两边都有吧……我可以和 Sensei 谈,但你知道他那个人。还有 Sara,但那也感觉不太对。而我所有的朋友们都只是……

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm10
: Wait, how do you even know where I live? I’ve never told you my address or room number.
lines.zh: : 等等,你到底是怎么知道我住哪的?我从没告诉过你我的地址或房间号。

lines.en: : Akira told me after I asked him what was going on with you. And don’t give me too much credit for coming since he was the one who ultimately pushed me to do this.
lines.zh: : 我问他你最近怎么了之后,他告诉我的。也别把我的前来想得太高尚——最终推我一把的人是他。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm11
: Oh...so you didn’t really want to-
lines.zh: : 哦……所以你其实并不是真的想——

lines.en: : No! No, no, no. Not like that. I just...you know...I’m your karate instructor. We’re not, like...close or...you know, right? Like, its probably weird for me to chase you down to...do stuff.
lines.zh: : 不!不不不。不是那个意思。我只是……你懂的……我是你的空手道教官。我们并不算……亲近,或者……你懂的,对吧?就是说,我跑来追着你……做这种事,大概挺怪的。

lines.en: : It’s not weird...
lines.zh: : 一点也不怪……

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm12
: It’s...it’s not?
lines.zh: : 不……不怪吗?

lines.en: : I don’t think so. And Sensei didn’t either if he told you to come. So why do you seem so nervous right now?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。而且如果 Sensei 让你来,那他也不觉得。所以你现在为什么看起来这么紧张?

lines.en: : That’s...uhh...
: Are you attracted to me, Miss Osaka? What will Miss Watabe think?
lines.zh: : 你被我吸引了吗,Osaka 老师?Watabe 老师会怎么想?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm13
: Okay, now you’re just acting like him. Show me you know better than that, please.
lines.zh: : 好了,你现在净学他那一套。请让我看看,你比这有分寸得多,拜托。

lines.en: : MMMMHNGHMNMHMNMHMM!!!
lines.zh: : MMMMHNGHMNMHMNMHMM!!!

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm14
: So, uhh...interesting decor choice you’ve got there.
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……你这里的装饰选择还挺有意思。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. My collection of Sensei pictures.
lines.zh: : 啊,对。我的 Sensei 照片收藏。

lines.en: : I’m sure he’d let me take more now if I asked him to, but I kind of like the sleeping ones. I think I have a real eye for photography.
lines.zh: : 我确定只要我现在开口,他会让我拍更多,但我还挺喜欢睡颜那几张的。我觉得我在摄影方面颇有眼光。

lines.en: : ...Right.
scene osakoayanedorm15
: I have extras if you want any. Framed ones. You won’t even have to go to the store or measure sizes or anything.
lines.zh: : 你要的话我还有多的。带相框的。你连店都不用去,也不用量尺寸什么的。

lines.en: : Is now a good time to remind you I’m the only girl in this city that doesn’t want to sleep with him?
lines.zh: : 现在是不是提醒你的好时机——我是这座城市里唯一不想和他上床的女孩?

lines.en: : Oh, right. Because you love me instead.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。因为你爱的是我。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm16
: Ayane, do you want to tell me what’s going on? And by “do you want to?” what I really mean is “can I pester you into telling me?” since I know you won’t do it on your own.
lines.zh: : Ayane,你想告诉我出了什么事吗?而「你想吗」的真正意思是「我能缠着你让我说吗」——因为我知道你自己绝不会开口。

lines.en: : I do, I just...it’s hard. And not just because I’m already bad at doing that. I just feel kind of...empty.
lines.zh: : 我想,只是……很难。而且不光是因为我本来就不擅长这个。我只是觉得有点……空。

lines.en: : Liiiiiike...depression?
lines.zh: : 你是说……抑郁?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm17
: I mean, I’m definitely depressed...but I don’t have depression.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,我确实很消沉……但我没有抑郁症。

lines.en: : This is different. Like...that feeling you get when you hop off of a train and keep thinking that you accidentally left something behind.
lines.zh: : 这不一样。就像……你跳下电车之后,一直觉得自己好像不小心落下了什么东西的那种感觉。

lines.en: : I get it. Just, when I feel that way, it’s normally because I did forget something.
lines.zh: : 我懂。只不过我有那种感觉的时候,通常是真的忘了东西。

lines.en: : It’s possible I did too. I just can’t remember what. And so now, every second that goes by, I’m trying to figure out what that something is.
lines.zh: : 我可能也是。只是我想不起来是什么。所以现在,每过一秒,我都在试图弄清那个东西到底是什么。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm18
: But the weirdest part is that I feel like I’ve felt this way before. That I’ve had this exact conversation before. Just with someone else where you are now.
lines.zh: : 但最怪的是,我感觉我以前有过这种感觉。以前有过一模一样的这段对话。只是坐在你现在位置上的,是别人。

lines.en: : Well, what did they do? Because the only counseling experience I have is through Akira and Wakana and the two of them are stubborn as fuck and refuse to actually listen.
lines.zh: : 那他们当时怎么办的?因为我仅有的开导经验都来自 Akira 和 Wakana,而这两位固执得要命,拒绝真正听进去。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm19
: I don’t know...I guess I must have figured it out if those feelings eventually went away. Things just feel kind of different this time.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我想,既然那些感觉最终消失了,那我应该是想通了吧。只是这一次,事情的感觉有点不一样。

lines.en: : Like...kind of like how I just forgot how to actually be happy in general. To the point where even thinking about happiness makes me feel kind of...guilty, I guess?
lines.zh: : 就像……好像我干脆忘记了该怎么真正快乐。到了一种连「想到快乐」都会让我觉得有点……愧疚的程度,我猜?

lines.en: : So, in a sense, you’re lacking something that makes you feel whole.
lines.zh: : 所以,从某种意义上说,你缺少了某个能让你感到完整的东西。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm20
: Yeah...does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 是……这么说通吗?

lines.en: : Of course. I’m the same way too, you know. Just with purpose as a concept instead of some vague article or idea I can’t remember.
lines.zh: : 当然说得通。你知道吗,我也一样。只是我缺的是「目的」这个概念,而不是某件想不起来的模糊物件或想法。

lines.en: : Really? You’ve always seemed so cool to me, though.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?可是在我眼里,你一直都很酷。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm21
: Thanks. You’re probably not very hard to impress though if that fuckin’ oaf of a teacher managed to win your heart to the point of you snapping photos of him in his sleep.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过你可能并不难被打动——毕竟连那个蠢得像头牛的老师都赢得了你的心,赢得你都开始在他睡觉时偷拍照片了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...hearts can be kind of vulnerable and easy to snatch up if you get the timing right.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这个嘛……心脏这种东西挺脆弱的,只要时机对,很容易就被一把捞走。

lines.en: : And Sensei was there for me when my parents weren’t. So everything after that was just falling.
lines.zh: : 而在我父母不在的时候,Sensei 在。所以那之后的一切,都只是坠落而已。

lines.en: : How very romantic and not at all creepy.
lines.zh: : 多么浪漫,而且一点也不吓人。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm22
: I know how it sounds. But he really didn’t spend long in the “dad” role before I started to see him as something more.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来像什么。但他真正待在「爸爸」这个角色里的时间其实不长,很快我就开始把他看成别的东西了。

lines.en: : The time he did spend in it, though?...I think you’d be surprised to see just how well he did. He can be pretty amazing when he actually tries to be. He just...doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 可他待在那个角色里的那段日子?……我想你会惊讶于他做得有多好。只要他真心想做,他可以相当了不起。他只是……不做。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm23
: But what’s weird is that even that thought makes me sad now when it used to make me feel so comfortable.
lines.zh: : 但怪就怪在,连这个念头如今都让我难过,而它从前是让我感到安心的。

lines.en: : Like all the things that brought me joy are gone. And all that’s left is the faint sound of birds in the back of my mind.
lines.zh: : 好像所有曾带给我快乐的东西都不见了。只剩下脑海深处隐约的鸟鸣。

lines.en: : How long will it be until they sing something happy, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 我在想,还要多久,它们才会唱点什么快乐的歌?

lines.en: : Jesus. Wakana would have loved that.
lines.zh: : 天。Wakana 会爱死这句的。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm24
: Sorry, I...that’s just...how it’s been lately. I’m...kind of a wreck. Hahah...
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我……最近就是……这样。我……算是有点破碎。哈哈……

lines.en: : Well, what can I do?
lines.zh: : 那么,我能做什么?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm25
: Huh?
: To make you feel better. Which isn’t to say I expect to just magically cure you of sadness. But there’s gotta be something, right? Even if it’s small.
lines.zh: : 让你好受一点的。我不是说我能魔法般地治好你的悲伤。但总有点什么能做的,对吧?哪怕很小。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm26
: Something tells me, you’ve already done as much as you can.
lines.zh: : 有种直觉告诉我,你已经做到你能做的极限了。

lines.en: : Huh...Well, then either you really like flowers or I’m even less cut out for this than I thought.
lines.zh: : 呃……那,要么你是真的喜欢花,要么我干这个比自以为的还不在行。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm27
: I think I just really like flowers. And I think you should stop doubting yourself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我只是真的喜欢花。另外我觉得,你该停止怀疑自己了。

lines.en: : Noted. I’ll get on that as soon as you remember what it is you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 收到。等你想起你到底在找什么,我就立刻照办。

lines.en: : I think I’ll be looking for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 我想,我会找上很长一段时间。

lines.en: : Don’t forget to pack a lunch then. And let me know when you find it.
lines.zh: : 那别忘了带上午餐。找到了也告诉我一声。

lines.en: : I will, Miss Osaka. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我会的,Osaka 老师。我保证。

lines.en: : You know I don’t mind if you call me Osako, right? Think it’s pretty clear I’ve moved out of the “just a teacher” role now that I’m in your bedroom.
lines.zh: : 你知道你直接叫我 Osako 我也不介意,对吧?我都进你卧室了,想必很明显,我早就搬出「只是个老师」那个角色了吧。

lines.en: : Right, sorry. I’ve only just started calling Sensei by his real name, so...maybe I’m just slow with that?
lines.zh: : 好,抱歉。我也是才开始叫 Sensei 的真名,所以……可能我就是在这方面比较慢热?

lines.en: : Nothing wrong with being slow. Especially with how quickly life tries to backhand you sometimes. Patience gives you a little more breathing room between all the pain.
lines.zh: : 慢热没什么不好。尤其是生活有时候抽你耳光抽得那么快的时候。耐心能让你在重重痛苦之间,多出一小口喘息的余地。

lines.en: : That statement implies that there would be no pain within the breathing room and I have discovered lately that things are quite the opposite.
lines.zh: : 你这话听起来,像是喘息的余地里就没有痛苦了。而我最近发现,事情恰恰相反。

lines.en: : Nice. All I’ve discovered lately is that my favorite student has become just as cynical and miserable as the guy who should be raising her instead of romancing her.
lines.zh: : 妙。我最近发现的只有:我最喜欢的学生,变得和那个本该养育她、而不是跟她谈恋爱的家伙一样愤世、一样悲惨。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm28
: If we want to get technical, my real dad is the one who should be doing that. He’s too busy with bubblewrap, though.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,该做那件事的是我亲爸。不过他忙着摆弄气泡膜呢。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forget he’s not dead sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。有时候我都会忘了他没死。

lines.en: : Can you teach me how to think he is?
lines.zh: : 你能教教我怎么才能当他是死了吗?

lines.en: : Probably not. But I could give you a crash course on how to make your family think you are. And all you need is a closet.
lines.zh: : 大概不能。但我可以给你开一门速成课,教你怎么让家人以为你死了。你需要的只是一柜衣柜。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm29
: Oof.
: Just a little joke. My parents have always accepted me. Always knew it too. Can’t say the same for extended family but, hey — that’s just how it goes sometimes.
lines.zh: : 开个小玩笑。我父母一直接受我。而且一直都知道。亲戚那边就不能同日而语了,不过嘛——有些事本来就是这样。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm30
: Do you want any kids, Miss...uh...sorry...Osako?
lines.zh: : 你想要孩子吗,Osaka……呃……抱歉……Osako?

lines.en: : Me? There’s no way I could be a mom. I’m horrible with kids.
lines.zh: : 我?我不可能当得了妈妈。我和小孩处不来。

lines.en: : That’s not what I asked, though. You can be horrible with them and still want them.
lines.zh: : 可我问的不是这个。就算和小孩处不来,也可以想要他们。

lines.en: : Sure, I guess. It’s just a much harder task for people like me.
lines.zh: : 也许吧,我想。只是对像我这样的人来说,那是一件艰难得多的任务。

lines.en: : Rin’s moms did it, didn’t they? And you’re friends with the one in our school, right? Maybe she could give you tips or something?
lines.zh: : Rin 的两位妈妈不就做到了吗?而且你和我们学校那位是朋友,对吧?也许她能给你支支招什么的?

lines.en: : It’s honestly a miracle anyone trusted a child in the hands of that woman. She seems like a good mom all things considered, though.
lines.zh: : 说真的,居然有人放心把一个孩子交到那个女人手里,简直是奇迹。不过全面来看,她似乎是个好妈妈。

lines.en: : I think you’d be a good mom, too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也会是个好妈妈。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm31
: Me? Who needed to be convinced to just come talk to you? Thanks, but no. I’m not cut out for something like that. You need confidence to be a mother and I just...don’t have that. At all.
lines.zh: : 我?一个光是来和你聊聊都需要别人劝的人?谢了,还是算了。我干不来那种事。当妈妈需要自信,而我根本……没有那东西。一点都没有。

lines.en: : But confidence is something you can develop. And, for all you know, the you five years from now might be unrecognizable from the you you are now.
lines.zh: : 可自信是可以培养的东西。而且谁知道呢,五年后的你,说不定和现在的你判若两人。

lines.en: : Again, maybe. But that’s still not taking into account just how drastically a child would change my life. And that’s not even touching on how Wakana feels.
lines.zh: : 又来了,也许吧。但这依然没算上一个孩子会把我的生活改变得有多剧烈。更别提 Wakana 的感受了。

lines.en: : I don’t even know how you feel yet, though. You keep deflecting the question with different potential obstacles.
lines.zh: : 可我连你的真实感受都还不知道呢。你一直在用各种假想障碍岔开问题。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm32
: It’s not an easy question, Ayane. Not everyone is born like you. Someone who just knows they want to be a mother one day.
lines.zh: : 这不是个容易回答的问题,Ayane。不是每个人都像你一样,生下来就知道自己有一天想当妈妈。

lines.en: : Sorry, I...I wasn’t trying to offend you or anything...
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我……我没有想冒犯你的意思……

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm33
: I’m not offended, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 我没被冒犯,只是……

lines.en: : It’s not something I grew up thinking...would ever really happen. Like....going on a trip to Hawaii or something. Just...way more dramatic and scary than that.
lines.zh: : 那不是我从小到大认为……真的会发生的事。就像……去夏威夷旅行什么的。只是……比那戏剧化得多、吓人得多。

lines.en: : So...a dream.
lines.zh: : 所以……是个梦。

lines.en: : Or lack thereof? Like, sure...poor people can dream about Hawaii too. But it’s not like they ever expect it to actually happen.
lines.zh: : 或者是梦的缺席?就是说,当然……穷人也可以梦见夏威夷。但他们从来不会指望它真的发生。

lines.en: : But...they want it to happen. And you still won’t even say that.
lines.zh: : 可是……他们希望它发生。而你连这个都不肯说。

lines.en: : Osako-
lines.zh: : Osako——

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm34
: Ayane, I am not the biggest fan of myself. And I am not interested in subjecting a child to a me who can’t even figure out who or what she is yet.
lines.zh: : Ayane,我不算太喜欢我自己。我也没兴趣把一个孩子,交给一个连自己是谁、是什么都还没搞明白的我。

lines.en: : I’m a lesbian. I’m young. I live in a small apartment. Wakana and I are both extremely busy. We don’t have the time or energy for a dog, let alone a kid.
lines.zh: : 我是个蕾丝边。我还年轻。我住一间小公寓。我和 Wakana 都忙得要死。我们连养条狗的时间精力都没有,更别说一个孩子。

lines.en: : We have to think about ourselves before anyone else. And besides, Wakana hates children with a burning passion. She can barely tolerate you guys and you’re not even that much younger than us.
lines.zh: : 我们得先考虑自己,再考虑别人。而且,Wakana 对小孩恨之入骨。她连你们都勉强忍受,而你们也没比我们小多少。

lines.en: : She’d never agree to this. She’d be signing her life away, and I don’t blame her for that at all.
lines.zh: : 她绝不会同意的。那等于签下她的一生,而我完全不怪她。

lines.en: : Okay...but...
scene osakoayanedorm35
: But in a perfect world...
lines.zh: : 可是在一个完美的世界里……

lines.en: : Where none of that is true...
lines.zh: : 在那一切都不成立的世界上……

lines.en: : Where it’s no longer impossible...
lines.zh: : 在那不再是不可能的世界里……

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm36
: I should probably go. But you can text me if you need me, okay? And I hope you feel at least...slightly better soon. Sad Ayane sucks.
lines.zh: : 我大概该走了。需要我的话可以给我发短信,好吗?我希望你至少……能快点好起来一点。悲伤的 Ayane 真糟糕。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I didn’t realize bringing this up would be difficult for you. Can I just...say one last thing, though?
lines.zh: : 对不起……我没意识到提起这个会让你为难。不过我能……说最后一件事吗?

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm37
: You probably shouldn’t, but...fine.
lines.zh: : 你最好别说,但……行吧。

lines.en: : If you do want to be a mom...but Miss Watabe doesn’t...maybe you two are-
lines.zh: : 如果你其实想当妈妈……但 Watabe 老师不想……也许你们俩可以——

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm38
: Actually, on second thought, I don’t think I should hear this. But uhhhh...texts. Together. Do it. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 其实,再一想,我觉得我不该听这段。但呃啊啊……短信。一起发。去做。对。

lines.en: scene osakoayanedorm39
: Yeah...
: Goodnight, Ayane. Sorry I’m...
lines.zh: : 晚安,Ayane。抱歉我……

lines.en: : Yeah.
scene osakoayanedorm40
scene black
: Thank you for the flowers...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的花……

jump osakospring9
